description: This PHP class defines the Store controller for administrative event handling within the OpenCart system. It includes methods to add, edit, and delete store entities, each of which schedules a task related to store management.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller handling store-related events in the admin panel, facilitating task scheduling for add, edit, and delete store operations.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Schedules a task to generate a new store list when a store is added.

methods.name: editStore
methods.description: Schedules a task to update the store list when a store is edited.

methods.name: deleteStore
methods.description: Schedules a task to update the store list when a store is deleted.
